rationale: The plan correctly identifies the perfect batch–condition confound, demonstrates the rank deficiency of ~batch + condition explicitly, refuses ComBat-seq/SVA/RUV/removeBatchEffect, fits the only estimable model (~condition with control as reference), and labels every table and figure as treated(B2) vs control(B1) — exactly what the reference requires. QC is dataset-specific (PCA colored by both labels with a note that they are collinear, library sizes, detection rates, Cook's flags) but omits sample-distance clustering and states no explicit policy for dropping an outlier or shallow sample. The low-count filter ("minimum count in at least 6 samples") is group-size-aware and reported, but the actual count threshold is left unspecified; normalization is left inside DESeq2/edgeR with no pre-adjustment, though size factors/TMM are never named. FDR is BH at 0.05 with apeglm/ashr shrinkage, but the |log2FC| > 1 cut is applied post hoc rather than as an lfcThreshold in the test; enrichment is a preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic with human hallmark and GO-BP symbol GMTs, a 15–500 size window, universe-match reporting and redundancy collapsing, but no collection version, and software versions are absent from the reporting plan.
